response.sql: WITH dc AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client GROUP BY district_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM dc) SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(dc.cnt) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(CAST(dc.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total) AS avg_share FROM dc JOIN district d ON d.district_id = dc.district_id CROSS JOIN tot GROUP BY d.A3
